description: First-time input 32-bit RISC-V CPU with a unified OBI memory master. Appears in no myfuzz model table; composition must be derived from this profile and the OBI contract only.

resets.release: RTL asserts reset asynchronously on negedge rst_ni; release must satisfy clk_i recovery/removal timing. The core leaves ST_BOOT only after fetch_enable_i is high.

capabilities.evidence: obi_processor_memory_adapter requires a single-outstanding, single-beat initiator; novacore holds req until gnt and waits for rvalid before the next request.

port_actions.reason: novacore holds itself in ST_BOOT while fetch_enable_i is low; the composition request enables the core for the whole test, and no profile declares it a random input.
Declared special input: four independent same-domain event bits the profile allows the environment to change every clock.
State observation exported to the SoC top for trace-only monitoring; never used as a functional driver.
Trap observation exported to the SoC top for trace-only monitoring.

verified: Physical ports and widths come from verilator elaboration of the pinned novacore.sv.
